name: Kamado Tanjiro

ruler.note: Every production sheet draws the upright figure at the same physical size, so every clip shares one resample factor (340 / 430 = 0.79). 6 heads matches the generated v3 model sheet (measured about 5.7-6).
ruler.scale_note: approved_head_px: hair top to chin on the approved idle key. model_head_px / model_height_px: hair top to chin and hair top to sole on the v3 model sheet; the runtime head is runtime_standing_px * model_head_px / model_height_px.

palette.note: Material targets in sRGB, sampled from the approved anime-v2 model sheet (k-means). Re-measured from the approved v3 idle key at checkpoint 1.

identity: Kamado Tanjiro: athletic teenage swordsman, 6 heads tall; burgundy-red spiky hair darker at the roots; dark red eyes; small scar on the left side of his forehead; hanafuda earrings; open haori with a green and black checkerboard (equal square size everywhere) and white lining; dark maroon-black Demon Slayer Corps jacket with white collar trim and silver buttons; white belt with square buckle; matching wide trousers gathered below the knee; white leg wraps with small straps; dark sandals with red thongs; black Nichirin katana with black blade, red and black hilt wrap, black scabbard on the left hip.
style: Crisp premium anime ink outlines with consistent line weight, flat cel shading with one shadow tone, modern 2D fighting-game sprite finish.

canon.portrait: Face, eyes, hair, forehead scar and earrings
canon.colours: haori green #549e82 with black #1e1e1e squares, the squares the same size on every view (about 70 px); jacket and trousers dark maroon-black #3a1f28; skin #f7ceaa.
canon.model_pose: relaxed neutral standing, arms slightly away from the body, calm face, katana sheathed on the left hip.
candidates: Column 1, Water Breathing middle guard: both hands on the hilt in front of the navel, blade pointing forward and up toward the opponent's eyes, knees bent, weight centred, front foot forward, rear heel slightly raised; calm determined face, mouth closed.
Column 2, low ready stance: wider stance with the torso leaning slightly forward, both hands on the hilt at hip height, blade held low and pointing forward and down past the front knee; alert eyes.
Column 3, side-on guard: torso turned more sideways, both hands at chest height, blade almost horizontal pointing straight at the opponent at chest height, rear knee bent more.

All three: the whole katana clearly visible (black blade, red and black hilt wrap, tsuba), scabbard on the left hip, haori open and hanging naturally with a slight flare at the hem, earrings visible, checker squares the same size as the model sheet.

portrait_note: Face, eyes, hair and forehead scar

prompt.note: Rulers measured on the approved key (input image 1 of every production sheet).
prompt.katana: the blade from the guard to the tip is about 350 px in every drawing, as long as in input image 1. Never shorten it; when it points across the body or straight forward, show its full length.
prompt.katana_edit: the blade from the guard to the tip is about 350 px, as long as in input image 1. Never shorten it.
prompt.effects: water, fire, trails or speed lines

anatomy.note: Inclusive OpenCV HSV boxes (h 0-179, wraps when low > high; s and v 0-255). Burgundy hair, peach skin, dark-maroon uniform.

materials.note: Costume classes for the colour lock; only the locked ones are corrected (hair also catches trouser highlights, so it is QA only).

awakening.note: The forehead scar grows into the flame-shaped mark (awaken.py).

qa.note: upright: hair-top-to-sole height of "upright" pose clips vs the idle (standing is about 5% taller than the bent-knee guard). sample_clips: awakened-vs-base pixel check in tests/art_v3_tests.py. idle_vs_upright: his idle (bent-knee guard, 327 atlas px) as a share of standing (340): tests/fate_revision_tests.gd divides every idle by it to compare standing heights (added with Nezuko's checkpoint 4; read as 1.0 before).
